summary.prose: Separate unsigned v2 build artifacts from protected main release candidates, and keep testing and qualification local.

tasks.title: Implement branch and readiness admission
tasks.summary: Update the build workflow and candidate packager to derive branch/lane from the dispatch ref and emit run-attempt metadata. Keep main default off.
acceptanceChecks: Protected and ready main builds a release candidate; unsigned v2 builds a development candidate even when release readiness is off.
Unsupported refs, incorrect dispatch SHA and missing main readiness fail before a job. No signing credentials or hosted tests are available to the v2 job.

tests.name: Local branch routing and candidate metadata

tasks.title: Bind the exact candidate origin
tasks.summary: Verify GitHub attempt and artifact identity from both signing workflows, make the signed manifest and qualification record carry identical origin data, and reject pre-policy or cross-attempt records.
acceptanceChecks: Only successful exact main attempts and matching immutable artifacts are eligible.
Promotion rejects wrong repository, branch, workflow, SHA, run, attempt, artifact, expiration or payload digest, including byte-identical reruns.

tests.name: Exact attempt and signed archive provenance

tasks.title: Enforce signing policy and live shutdown
tasks.summary: Enforce main-only environment configuration and live readiness after approvals, before signing, and before each publish write. Preserve the two-key model and existing exact-archive checks.
acceptanceChecks: Both environment policies require main-only refs, designated reviewers and no self-approval/bypass. Missing or unverifiable live policy aborts.
Disabling readiness while awaiting approval or after signing refuses the next operation; v2 and tags never reach signing.

tests.name: Local environment policy and live disable checks

tasks.title: Document and verify staged rollout
tasks.summary: Document the narrow default-branch workflow landing, operator setup and shutdown/reconciliation. Verify unsigned v2 can build before main release activation.
acceptanceChecks: Runbook defers enabling main until packaging/installer, branch protection and environment configuration are verified.
Local end-to-end fixtures prove pre-test signing, evidence approval, byte-preserving promotion, and cancellation guidance. No release is dispatched during implementation.

tests.name: Local staged rollout and release sequence

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: New local workflow policy fixture: main protected builds a release candidate, main unprotected refuses, v2 creates an unsigned development artifact, and all other refs refuse

New mocked GitHub API integration: main run plus matching artifact succeeds; v2 origin, mismatched run branch and artifact branch, wrong repository/workflow/commit/run ID or expired artifact all refuse before download or signing
New workflow wiring check: both qualification-sign and promotion enforce main provenance independently, dev jobs have no signing environment, and no Actions test commands are added

New local sequence coverage: qualification signature precedes verified test install; failed or absent local record blocks production signing; valid approved evidence admits the identical manifest/archive
New local GitHub policy fixtures: enforce exact main branch-only rules and reject a tag rule, extra branch rule, missing reviewers, self-approval, bypass, unavailable policy and v2 environment access
New mocked API test: failed attempt 1 plus successful attempt 2; reject attempt 1 and cross-attempt artifact substitution, accept only successful matching attempt
New local job-admission tests: missing or false readiness blocks main build before runner and both signing workflows, but v2 development still builds
New test: two successful main attempts with the same commit and archive bytes; substitute attempt or artifact ID and assert promotion rejects the valid signature for the wrong identity

New test: readiness is true at scheduling and false after approval, or becomes false after signing; deny signing or the next publish mutation, respectively. Missing/read-failed live settings also fail closed.
